meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动回复 Linear 议题下的每条评论，无需 @ 提及。每个议题的评论线程会成为一个独立的对话。
howto.when: 当有人在已配置的 Linear 团队议题下发表评论时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这个议题的评论。
say.note: Claude 会读取并回复该议题的评论线程。

say.text: 这个 bug 的根因是什么？
say.note: Claude 会在议题评论中给出分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically replies to every comment on Linear issues without needing an @-mention. Each issue's comment thread becomes a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone comments on an issue in the configured Linear team.

say_en.text: Check the comments on this issue.
say_en.note: Claude reads and replies to the issue's comment thread.

say_en.text: What is the root cause of this bug?
say_en.note: Claude provides analysis in the issue comments.
